steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Set up app package name com.smartocrscanner.app and application identity for Smart OCR Scanner.

steps.title: Define Schema Configuration
steps.description: Configure api_schema.json and admin_setting_schema.json for offline stock management.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest & Activities
steps.description: Register inventory management activities, camera permissions, and FileProvider in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Define Color Palette & Style Resources
steps.description: Set up string resources, colors, and styles for Mobile Shop Inventory UI.

steps.title: Implement Data Models for Inventory & Logs
steps.description: Create MobileModel, ScanModel, and InventoryLogModel Java classes for shop stock tracking.

steps.title: Create Mobile OCR Text Parsing Utility
steps.description: Implement MobileOcrParser to automatically extract Brand, Model, IMEI 1/2, Serial, RAM, Storage, and Color from text.

steps.title: Setup SQLite Database Helper for Stock & History
steps.description: Configure ScanHistoryDbHelper with tables for scans, mobile inventory, and transaction logs.

steps.title: Build Main Dashboard Activity Layout
steps.description: Design activity_main.xml to display total stock, stock summary cards, quick action buttons, and recent entries.

steps.title: Fix Add/Edit Mobile Form Layout XML
steps.description: Ensure valid inputType attributes in activity_add_edit_mobile.xml and refine form inputs.

steps.title: Implement Add/Edit Mobile Form Logic
steps.description: Code AddEditMobileActivity for OCR camera/gallery pre-fill and manual mobile entry with duplicate IMEI validation.

steps.title: Implement Stock In Activity Logic
steps.description: Code StockInActivity for viewing incoming inventory, camera/gallery OCR intake, edit, and delete functions.

steps.title: Implement Stock Out Activity Logic
steps.description: Code StockOutActivity to search inventory by IMEI/Serial/Model, record customer sales details, and mark devices as SOLD.

steps.title: Implement All Mobiles Inventory Screen
steps.description: Code AllMobilesActivity with live search, status filters (Available/Sold), and device operations.

steps.title: Implement Audit History Activity Logic
steps.description: Code HistoryActivity for reviewing Stock In, Stock Out, edits, and deletions with timestamped logs.

steps.title: Integrate ML Kit Text Recognition with Main Dashboard
steps.description: Connect ML Kit text recognition with mobile auto-parser in MainActivity and ResultActivity.

steps.title: Building Smart OCR Scanner
steps.description: Compile final APK package and verify offline Mobile Shop Stock Management execution.
